text:
anika: Heads-up — I found a handful of broken quicklinks and inconsistent SDK snippets across Optimize docs (batching, cache, quant profiles). Can we do a quick sweep? :wave:

matt: Yup saw that too. Which pages are worst?

anika: /optimize/batching-guide (link to caching section wrong), /optimize/quant-profiles/examples (snippet uses old SDK call), and a stray link in /examples/embed-cache.md.
sara: The quant example uses `client.generate()` but our SDK v2 uses `client.responses.create()` — that causes confusion in the migration guide.

leo: I can take the batching/caching links. Will open a tiny PR to redirect the anchor targets and add a note.

anika: Thanks. Matt, can you own the SDK snippet fix in quant profiles? It's used in two places.
matt: Yep. I'll update both examples and add a brief note explaining the v1->v2 mapping. Drafting now.

docs-bot: PR #4321 created by leo: fix/optimize-batch-cache-anchors — CI: pending

leo: Quick question — do we prefer keeping old v1 examples in a legacy callout or remove them entirely?

anika: Keep them but collapse into a <details> block with a clear migration header. We still get search traffic for v1.
sara: Also add a small code diff snippet for quant that shows the mapping, e.g.:
```
# v1
resp = client.generate(model="x", prompt=prompt)

# v2
resp = client.responses.create(model="x", input=prompt)
```

matt: Good. I'll add that exact diff and mention tokenization caveats.

anika: For the quicklinks, can we also add a short index at top of /optimize that points to batching, caching, and quant profiles? Users kept reporting they couldn't find the cache TTL section.

leo: On it. I'll add an anchor list and run a link-checker. Anyone want to review the PR?

sara: I can review quant snippets.
matt: I'll review link PR once CI is green.
anika: Plan: leo lands anchors PR, matt lands snippet PR, sara reviews quant changes. Goal: merge by end of day tomorrow.

docs-bot: PR #4321 CI: passed ✅

leo: Merged #4321. Added top-level quicklinks + a micro-TOC for optimize.
matt: PR #4322 opened: fix/quant-sdk-snippets — includes code diff and a brief note about caching behavior with 8-bit quantized models.

sara: Reviewing now. Left one inline about clarifying batch-size tradeoffs with small sequence lengths.
matt: Thanks — pushed a fix.
anika: Awesome team. After merge, I'll run a short blurb in #docs announcing the fixes and link to the updated pages. :tada:

leo: One follow-up: we should add a tiny test to our docs CI that checks for common old-call patterns (`client.generate(`). I can open a follow-up issue.
anika: Please do. That will prevent regressions.

matt: Filed issue #598: docs-ci-detect-deprecated-sdk-calls.

anika: Closing the thread once all merges are done — leaving this open until tomorrow. Thanks everyone!
